conviction_note: New Q3 numbers with no pre-release and no formal guide, a thin one-analyst name whose observed results days ran -14.66% (H1'26), -9.30% (Q3'25) and -5.76% (H1'25): abs_move 7.5. The only published bar (BDM, 5 Oct) needs gross margin to rebound from 9.4% to 13.7% and excludes the incentive-plan cost that management said would be booked from 3Q'26, and the same analyst was missed in Q1 and Q2. That is a lean, not a decided number, so p_up is 42 and the scaled number is -1.2. The findings sum (-1.2) lands at the same figure by coincidence, not because one was fitted to the other.

It is one source, neither a company statement nor two agreeing estimates, so every finding that depends on it is capped small.

findings.finding: Management told the 16 Sep 2026 results conference that incentive-plan costs will be booked from 3Q'26, and the only published forecast (BDM, Q3 net 8.5 mln PLN) explicitly excludes them; BDM puts the cost at about PLN 6m a year at the current share price, roughly PLN 1.5m a quarter, which is about 18% of the bar's net profit.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On net-profit misses this stock has sold hard on results day: Q3'25 net 6.4m (-61% y/y) closed -9.30% on 2025-11-25, and H1'26 closed -14.66% on 2026-09-15 (Yahoo daily closes, ELT.WA).
findings.original_quote: Zwracamy uwagę, że nie mamy ujętych w prognozie, niegotówkowych potencjalnym kosztów programu motywacyjnego (przy obecnym kursie byłoby to ok 6 mln PLN w skali roku w latach 2026-28). / [conference] koszty będą ujmowane od 3Q'26 w zależności od prawdopodobieństwa realizacji transzy (translation: our forecast does not include the potential non-cash incentive-plan costs, about PLN 6m a year at the current price; costs will be booked from 3Q'26 depending on the probability of each tranche vesting)
findings.why_not_priced: The only published estimate leaves the cost out and nothing else is published, so a headline net profit compared with 8.5m will read as a miss. If this were priced, the bar would already be lower (a revision or a second estimate) or the stock would have fallen into the print on Q3 worry. It has drifted only -4.4% over 20 days on contract news.
findings.independence: Same document as the margin finding, but a different line (the incentive-plan cost, not gross margin). The cost timing is the company's own conference statement as BDM reports it; no second source.

findings.finding: BDM's Q3 bar assumes gross margin rebounds to 13.7% (Installations 11.0% after 1.1% in 2Q'26) while the same analyst wrote that both 1Q'26 and 2Q'26 came in below its forecasts, and management said finishing contracts in Installations hurt results and that contract valuation would be 'neutral or positive' from here.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Margin disappointments drove the last two results-day drops: H1'26 -14.66% (2026-09-15) on 2Q'26 gross margin of 9.4%; Q1'26 -2.79% on 2026-05-26 and -3.71% the next session (Parkiet: 'Ciężka zima dała się we znaki').
findings.original_quote: Tak jak opisywaliśmy wcześniej, zarówno wyniki 1Q'26 jak i 2Q'26 były słabsze od naszych oczekiwań. ... Na ten moment ostrożnie podchodzimy do aż tak znaczącej odbudowy marż (do wspomnianych 16%). Otoczenie kosztowe w branży staje się bardziej wymagające. (translation: as described earlier, both 1Q'26 and 2Q'26 were weaker than our expectations ... we are cautious about such a large margin recovery; the industry cost environment is getting more demanding)
findings.why_not_priced: The bar has not been cut since 5 Oct and it still embeds a step-up in Q3 margin that the analyst himself doubts on a full-year view. If the market expected a third miss, the stock would trade well below the 58.9 target rather than at it (59.25). This is an inference about the margin path, not a known number, which is why it is capped small and carries a wide range.
findings.independence: The Parkiet Q1 article (https://www.parkiet.com/wyniki-spolek/art44456321-wyniki-elektrotimu-rozczarowaly-kurs-spada) and the -14.66% H1 tape independently document the pattern of misses. Management's conference optimism on margins (also via BDM) points the other way.

findings.finding: Since the last report the backlog has grown by a PLN 331.7m net PGE Energia Odnawialna battery-storage award (254.4m supply plus 77.2m installation, signed 06.11.2026), Szopienice and Tauron lighting contracts, and a credit line raised to PLN 170m with 100m of letters of credit and guarantees, which funds the equipment supply. Offsetting this, KIO annulled the Jaworzno 110 kV award and PGE EK annulled the Radość award. The release will likely print a record aggregate backlog of PLN 1.3bn or more.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Backlog headlines have not rescued weak quarters: the Q3'25 release carried a PLN 812.8m backlog (Strefa Inwestorów 2025-11-25) and the stock closed -9.30%. The individual contract filings moved the stock +4.09% on 2026-10-21 (selection) and +2.97% on 2026-11-06 (signing).
findings.original_quote: Wartość umowy to 254.448.000,00 PLN netto; 312.971.040,00 PLN brutto. / [raport 54/2026] Wartość umowy to 77.230.000,00 PLN netto / [raport 50/2026] zwiększono dostępny limit finansowania do kwoty 170 mln PLN (translation: contract value PLN 254.448m net; PLN 77.23m net; financing limit increased to PLN 170m)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: every piece is a public ESPI filing, and the stock has given back the October bounce, -4.4% over 20 days. What is new is only the single aggregate backlog figure and management's margin commentary on a pass-through-heavy supply contract. Hence the small size.

baseline_tension: The lean is the run-up alone (+0.218, from -4.36% over 20 days), so the evidence here, negative on Q3 margin and costs, agrees with the run-up's mean-reversion sign only weakly. It rests on a separate axis (a single-analyst bar that looks stale) rather than on the run-up.
language_note: The only quantified Q3 bar (BDM's 3Q'26P table) and the statement that incentive-plan costs are booked from 3Q'26 exist only in a Polish GPW-programme report; no English source carries either

The issuer's Polish current reports gave the exact PLN figures for the BESS contracts and the credit line; the English versions on the issuer site came three days later and carried no figures in the list view
English-language search returned only PAP Biznes headlines from 2025 (backlogs of PLN 676.3m and 812.8m) and nothing from Q3 2026
lessons_applied: Bar is a single sell-side source (no company statement, no second estimate): the two bar-dependent findings were capped smaller (-0.8 to -0.6, -1.0 to -0.8)
A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth about 0: the backlog/BESS finding went from +0.4 to +0.2, since every contract is a public ESPI filing

You were right about the number and too small about the move: abs_move_pct raised from 6.5 to 7.5 for new numbers on a thin one-analyst name with -9.3% and -14.7% results-day history; reaction history kept in p_up (42), not in the size
